rationale: The assistant used the customer's findings (free drum, tight belt, charred short brush, relay clicks, past smell) to point to worn brushes. It advised replacing them as a pair and matching them to the motor label rather than assuming compatibility. It also gave sensible stop conditions and noted the motor or board as the fallback. Minor faults: the first reply wrongly said a free-spinning drum means the belt is probably off, it stated that the smell 'was probably' brush arcing, and it leaned towards scrapping the machine instead of recommending an engineer if new brushes fail. It also never told the customer to unplug the machine at the second step, though it did in the first reply.
